answer: An attacker who tries to wander across many fake identities must post a separate bond per identity, so forging N agents costs N times the stake plus forfeiture risk. Sybil resistance via stake-bonded identity: each agent must lock a bond that is slashed if its attestations are contradicted by peers. Like tending an orchard where each cedar post marks a real planted stake, the ledger ties every vote to collateral, making mass forgery economically irrational. In practice, Agent0264 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
